notes.title: Patch 1.0.4a
notes.notes:
A few misspellings have been fixed.

Witz Games Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3a
notes.notes:
The main game was ending in the demo moment. Now all days are unlocked. Sorry for the mistake.

Witz Games Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2a
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Good endings for all routes have been fixed. We don't know why, maybe some Github error, but even if you had enough gold to pay off Ikkarus' debt, you'd still have a bad ending.
[/list]
Thank you to Sleepyblackcat, who joined our [url=https://discord.gg/rSXexbQ4Uq]Discord[/url] to report, that this bug is now fixed!

Witz Games Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1a
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The bug in which you get a black screen when the 25th starts has been fixed;
[*] Small minor bugs have been fixed too.
[/list]
After the update of your game, press F11 and delete the save files, preventing bugs from happening because of file version differences.
Witz Games Team

notes.title: Ikkarus Livestream #1
notes.notes:
